description: This file defines the `CellStyleAssessor` class, which is responsible for evaluating conditional formatting rules against a specific cell in a spreadsheet, and merging the resulting styles based on those rules.

classes.name: CellStyleAssessor
classes.description: Class responsible for assessing and merging styles for a cell based on conditional formatting rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the assessor with a cell and a conditional range, setting up the matcher and style merger.

methods.name: matchConditions
methods.description: Evaluates a list of conditional styles against the cell and merges applicable styles; stops if a rule is marked as stop if true.
